description: This file implements the WebSocket handshake processor for protocol version HyBi 00, including request validation, header parsing, challenge-response computation, and handshake response sending.

classes.name: Handshaker
classes.description: Handles the WebSocket handshake process for protocol version HyBi 00, including request validation, header processing, challenge computation, and response.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Handshaker with the request and dispatcher.

methods.name: do_handshake
methods.description: Performs the WebSocket handshake, setting request attributes and sending response.

methods.name: _set_resource
methods.description: Sets the ws_resource attribute based on request URI.

methods.name: _set_subprotocol
methods.description: Validates and sets the WebSocket subprotocol.

methods.name: _set_location
methods.description: Builds and sets the WebSocket location URL.

methods.name: _set_origin
methods.description: Sets the origin attribute if present.

methods.name: _set_protocol_version
methods.description: Validates and sets the WebSocket protocol version and stream.

methods.name: _set_challenge_response
methods.description: Computes and sets the challenge response MD5 hash.

methods.name: _get_key_value
methods.description: Extracts and validates key values from headers for challenge computation.

methods.name: _get_challenge
methods.description: Generates the challenge string by concatenating key parts and reading 8 bytes.

methods.name: _send_handshake
methods.description: Constructs and sends the handshake response to the client.
